children.name: How long does it take to complete a landing page?
children.characters: Do I need a registered company to become a Creator?

children.name: We offer both!
children.characters: No. The Creator journey begins before company incorporation.

children.name: How long does it take to complete a landing page?
children.characters: Do I need a complete business plan before joining?

children.name: We offer both!
children.characters: No. Business planning is part of the Project Intelligence journey.

children.name: How long does it take to complete a landing page?
children.characters: Does Mondial build the project for me?

children.name: We offer both!
children.characters: No. Mondial structures the process, provides tools and helps connect the project with relevant people and resources.

children.name: How long does it take to complete a landing page?
children.characters: Does AI decide whether my idea is good?

children.name: We offer both!
children.characters: No. AI helps structure information, identify assumptions and surface areas that may require evidence or review.

children.name: How long does it take to complete a landing page?
We offer both!
children.characters: Phase 05 can support a Full Buyout path where ownership may be transferred through an agreed acquisition process.

children.name: How long does it take to complete a landing page?
We offer both!
children.characters: The Co-founder / Equity path can support matching and founder discussions. Matching does not automatically create an equity agreement.

children.name: How long does it take to complete a landing page?
children.characters: Can I keep the project and build it myself?

children.name: We offer both!
children.characters: Yes. Build Yourself leads toward Verified Entrepreneur Level Up and the Entrepreneur journey.

children.name: How long does it take to complete a landing page?
children.characters: Do I lose the work I completed as a Creator?

children.name: We offer both!
children.characters: The structured project is designed to move forward with relevant information rather than forcing the Creator to restart.

children.name: How long does it take to complete a landing page?
children.characters: Can investors automatically see my project?

children.name: We offer both!
children.characters: No. Visibility depends on stage, permissions and relevant sharing or readiness workflows.

children.name: Final CTA Headline
children.characters:
Your idea does not need to be
finished.

children.name: Final CTA Description
children.characters: Start with the idea. Mondial will help you turn it into a structured project ready for validation, funding, or buyout.
